question: Should OpenClaw add a read-only depth/recursive mode to `subagents list` now, and should that surface be scoped to the `subagents` tool or wait for broader session-chain/tree API alignment?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the choice affects public slash-command and model-facing tool semantics plus subagent visibility boundaries.

options.title: Approve narrow recursive list
options.body: Add `depth`/`recursive` as read-only list options with parent/depth metadata while keeping the existing direct-child default and control permissions unchanged.

options.title: Fold into chain/tree design
options.body: Keep this issue open but defer implementation until session-chain metadata and the active-agent tree command settle the shared hierarchy contract.

options.title: Decline core list expansion
options.body: Keep direct `subagents` listing as the supported scope and steer users to session files or a future external observability plugin.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow recursive list
recommendation.body: Add `depth`/`recursive` as read-only list options with parent/depth metadata while keeping the existing direct-child default and control permissions unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent source history on the subagent control boundary and is the strongest owner signal for choosing public API and visibility semantics.
